title: Oozy Creamy British Mushroom Cottage Pie
description: A comforting British dish featuring sautéed mushrooms in a creamy oyster sauce-based filling, topped with a dairy-free mashed potato crust, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat and sauté the onion until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oyster sauce and flour, then add the non-dairy milk and whisk until smooth.
Pour the sauce mixture over the mushrooms and onion, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
While the filling is cooking, boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the dairy-free butter, salt, and pepper.
Transfer the filling to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the mashed potatoes, spreading them evenly to cover the filling.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
